messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER - High: Routing latency spike affecting EU->US path for redwood-hosted-api. Trigger: egress-steer latency p50 > 300ms. Affected region: eu-west2 observed fallback to us-west1. Pager: https://pd/INC-4821

alex_sre: I'm oncall, looking now. Assigning myself.

maria_net: I see BGP path churn in peering logs ~14:12 UTC, routes oscillating between us-west1 and us-central1. Mesh control-plane restarted at 14:07 UTC. Could be related.

jane_runtime: Observability: text-gen endpoints show increased tail latency and ~5% 502 errors. Traces indicate requests from EU are routing via US backends. Shard health is OK.

alex_sre: @maria_net any recent steering policy changes? We had a canary rollout earlier but I thought it was stable.

maria_net: We rolled out a latency-based steering canary for eu-west2 at 02:30 UTC. No full-policy changes since. Control-plane restart at 14:07 may have caused policy re-eval churn.

sam_oncall: Quick checks: DNS TTLs look normal (20s), but edge caches show expired pins, some clients still holding old pins resulting in sticky connections to US nodes.

lia_support: Customer ops reporting spikes from EU customers (payments infra, chat widgets). Received three SEV2 tickets from customers experiencing errors since ~14:10 UTC. If this persists we'll need an external status update.

alex_sre: Mitigation proposal: 1) Pause/rollback latency-steering policy 2) Force route-pin flush for eu-west2 edges 3) Drain affected edge cluster to drop stale connections 4) Increase wobble guard/TTL on steering decisions after stabilization.

maria_net: Rolling back policy now. Command:
```
# rollback latency steering policy to previous stable
kubectl -n control-plane apply -f /config/steer/latency-policy-stable.yaml
```

maria_net: Policy rollback applied; control plane reports policy state -> STABLE (previous canary reverted).

jane_runtime: Dashboards: new requests show p50 back to baseline, but existing pinned sessions still hitting US fallbacks and generating 502s. Need connection drain/flush.

alex_sre: Initiating connection drain for eu-west2-edge cluster:
```
redwoodctl cluster drain eu-west2-edge --grace 30s
```

sam_oncall: Drain in progress. Metrics indicate a drop in long-lived pinned sessions.

incident_bot: ACTION TAKEN -> policy rollback, cluster drain started, route-pin flush requested.

maria_net: Triggering edge cache pin flush to force clients to reselect local routes:
```
curl -X POST https://edge-api.internal/flush-pins -d '{"region":"eu-west2"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxxx'
```

maria_net: Edge API responded: 12000 pins flushed, cache invalidation queued.

lia_support: Customer ops: compiling impact window and messaging. Current estimated impact window 14:10 - 14:40 UTC. Coordinating with product comms.

customer_ops: Draft status page entry ready for approval. Will include brief root-cause summary, mitigation steps taken, and ETA for full recovery (~15 min).

alex_sre: Monitoring update: error rate down from ~5% -> ~0.8% over the last 10m. p95 for pinned sessions still elevated. Recommend keep network + runtime oncall watching for 1 hour then handoff.

jane_runtime: Preliminary hypothesis: control-plane restart caused transient policy evaluation noise; latency-steering overreacted and created oscillating pins. Stale connection affinity then caused EU traffic to be served by US fallbacks.

alex_sre: Adding this to the postmortem queue. I'll lead the postmortem and @maria_net will be network SME.

sam_oncall: Creating follow-up runbook item: add rollout guard to prevent simultaneous control-plane restart during steer policy promotions.

lia_support: Status page posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/4821 (customer-facing message sent).

customer_ops: Customers acknowledging updates; a few asked for a technical briefing. Scheduling a 17:00 UTC briefing with stakeholders.

alex_sre: Handoff plan: I'll hand off monitoring to next oncall @eve_oncall at 15:30 UTC. Please track pinned-session p95 and any routing flaps.

eve_oncall: Taking handoff at 15:30 UTC. Will keep watch and escalate if we see renewed oscillation.

incident_bot: INCIDENT UPDATED -> severity HIGH -> MEDIUM, mitigation steps recorded.

alex_sre: Closing thread for active mitigation; we'll keep the incident record open for postmortem and follow-ups. Attach logs to INC-4821 and add runbook tasks. Thanks everyone :tada:
